messages:
riley_cs: FYI OrchidTech renewal in 28 days. Procurement balked at the +10% list and asked for either a 9-month bridge at current price or acceptance of a PO at current price if submitted before month-end. They also want consolidated billing for EU entity.
devon_ae: Quick ask  can Finance approve a one-time 9mo concession? If yes I can push to close this week.
maria_billing: For EU consolidated billing we need their EU VAT ID and the target billing entity. If they want Redwood EU invoicing, we need their VAT and legal name. Also request vendor code early. Example PO format we prefer:
```
PO: ORCH-2026-772
Vendor code: 55433-RW
Billing entity: Redwood EU Services Ltd.
```
hana_legal: If we do a 9mo price-protect amendment I can draft a short addendum today. Include clause: "No list price increases during the 9-month term." Any SOW changes?
riley_cs: No SOW changes. They asked for a written guarantee of no mid-term price increases. Procurement warned vendor-code creation can take 10-12 days.
revops: Finance can approve the 9mo bridge as a one-off if AE+CS secure exec-level email confirming commitment and PO or signed amendment within 30 days. We can allow CC fallback for one billing cycle if PO delayed, but revenue recognition requires signed docs within 45 days.
devon_ae: I'll request exec email and vendor code now. @hana_legal please draft amendment with billing fields included so AP doesn't have to chase.
hana_legal: On it. Drafting now, will attach DocuSign link when ready.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: env-ORCH-9921 (status: draft)
riley_cs: Thanks all. I'll update once I have exec confirmation and the PO. :thumbsup:
